scope_findings: All 25 year identities and four numeric values per year are directly checked. Auxiliary complete rows agree with pixels.
Raw parser swaps t=6 and t=9 and loses the caption. Correct identities are retained in this supplement without overwriting raw parser output.

The displayed cumulative cash flow changes sign between years 10 and 11. A conditional linear interpolation of the displayed cash values gives about 10.09329 years, whereas original page 6 and conclusion report 10.5. No unstated interpolation method is assumed; the interval and exact published estimate are kept separately.
Saved cash flow uses 1.59 MAD/kWh for the first row. This savings conversion is distinct from the stated LCOE of 1.60 MAD/kWh.
